T008.s2: agree with the approach (yaw the landmarks about the planted ball, then twist the chest through the spine spread), amend two things. (1) The 12 deg/frame cap is too low for the turns it is meant for: spinning_back_kick goes from facing the target to back-to-target over f2-f3, about 0.10 s each, so ~90 deg in ~6 baked frames at 60 fps = 15 deg/frame; the cap would delay the turn past the kick. Set the cap from the bake rate (at least 25 deg/frame at 60 fps) or make it 1.5x the authored yaw speed, and keep it only as a pop guard. (2) Name the pivot when no ball is planted: jump kick, flying side kick, backflip and dive are airborne for the frames that need yaw. Use the pelvis (x,z) as the pivot when neither ball is within 3 cm of the floor, and say so in the reason. Verify additions: the planted-ankle slip metric must not rise on the nine moves with yaw 0 (no-op), and in the later authored step the toe direction of the pivot foot should turn with the yaw (a pivot, not a skid). Not blocking; proceed after these two edits to the reason.

problem: The three beam shaders from the Godot pack exist only as Godot code; nothing renders in the game.
evidence: energy_beam.gdshader (228 lines: tapered tube, vertex bend, 10 fragment styles), beam_flare (66), impact_shock (40), a 676-line script that builds 4 tube layers, flares, a shockwave and sparks; ten preset scenes (previews exist).
hypothesis: A Bevy Material with its own vertex shader (bend, radial pulses) and fragment styles reproduces the tube; the flare and shock become one billboard material.
action: New crates/game/src/play/energy.rs and assets/shaders/energy_beam.wgsl + energy_quad.wgsl: BeamMaterial, QuadMaterial, ten presets from the .tscn values, a spawn function, an animate system, and a smoke switch GB_BEAM=<preset> that fires one from the player. No spell uses it yet.
verify: cargo build; a 1920x1080 recording per preset next to its preview.png.
expect: Each preset reads like its preview: tube with its pattern, head flare, tip flare, shock on impact. No change when GB_BEAM is unset.
risks: WGSL differences from GLSL (mod, atan2); a Bevy vertex shader must match the mesh pipeline's bindings. Nothing else is touched.
text: Step T010.s1: port the beam tube, flare and shock to a Bevy material with a GB_BEAM smoke switch; no gameplay change. Object within about 15 min if you disagree.
